title: SM64DS Co-op 0.5.5 menu preview — Windows
notes:
Windows preview with the integrated retro co-op menu, three adventure-save cards, readable menu text and expanded backgrounds.

- Sound: 33 built-in DS themes, menu effects, MP3/FLAC/WAV custom music, individual-song playback, Shuffle Custom and Shuffle All.
- Display: eight built-in choices including a Staff Roll scenery tour; PNG/JPEG/BMP custom backgrounds.
- Custom media imports validate files, preserve existing files and store selections by filename. Unicode music filenames work on Windows.
- One program EXE, no BAT launcher or separate decoder DLL. The ZIP is about 3.4 MB; the executable is about 9.5 MiB. Game assets and custom media remain external.

Validation: native 32-bit build and engine memory/symbol guards; settings restart tests; all 33 songs and three effects produced audio; all supported custom formats and Unicode filenames passed; all twelve menu pages captured over eight backgrounds; scenery tour transition and 120-frame gameplay check passed. Portable menu/media CI passed on Windows, Linux and macOS with both desktop and handheld profiles.

This is a Windows prerelease. Native Linux/SteamOS, macOS, Android and iOS game binaries are not available: the engine still requires platform and ABI work. Portable CI is not a full game-port test. Online co-op, fresh-folder import and adventure save-loading still require additional runtime verification. Existing repository-wide dead-reference and asset-dependent port-build CI failures remain documented in PR #5. This preview is not a guarantee of a bug-free game.

Use your own supported .nds or existing extracted data. No ROMs, Nintendo assets/audio or player saves are included.

[Source changes and platform status](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/pull/5)
